headline: Fitch affirms UAE rating at 'AA-' with stable outlook, projects 2026 budget surplus
summary: Fitch Ratings affirmed the UAE's long-term rating at 'AA-' with a stable outlook, citing low consolidated government debt, robust net foreign assets, and sustained fiscal surpluses through 2026.
why: Sovereign credit ratings govern borrowing costs for national governments and public sector issuers.

impacts.name: United Arab Emirates
impacts.why: Affirmation of strong credit status supports low sovereign debt issuance yields.
